negative_search_likelihood.reason: Public source footprints cannot be converted into a missed-detection likelihood without spatial quality, holiday, and calibrated target-specific detection inputs.

required_inputs.input: reviewed mission swaths or validated coverage mask
authoritative Ocean Infinity 2018 and 2025-2026 AUV swaths
spatial sonar quality and confidence classes
complete holiday, low-probability-detection, and resurvey masks
target-state model including debris-field and burial/relief assumptions
calibrated PoD conditional on sensor, environment, target, and analyst process
navigation, swath-edge, overlap, and pass-dependence model

forbidden_shortcuts: treating catalog extents as uniform searched masks
treating approximate outlines or AIS tracks as AUV swaths
treating bathymetry as aircraft-target search coverage
assigning PoD=1 inside a footprint or PoD=0 outside it
turning narrative confidence language into an invented numeric PoD

planning_approximately_7500_km2.rounding_warning: The source calls 15,000 estimated and 7,571 approximate; 7,429 is not an exact remaining-area measurement.
spatial_blockers: authoritative machine-readable 15,000 km2 contract boundary not obtained
exact 2025-2026 surveyed AUV swaths not obtained
valid-data, holiday, and resurvey masks not obtained
spatial overlap with earlier searches cannot be computed
an unsurveyed difference polygon cannot be produced
planning_approximately_7500_km2.defensible_current_use: Generate two clearly conditional plans from a supplied impact posterior: posterior-mass-per-area ranking, and a separate proxy-aware/logistics sensitivity. Approximate outlines and AIS tracks are planning context only and never posterior updates, binary exclusions, or missed-detection likelihoods.

release_planner.posterior_density_method: deterministic Gaussian KDE evaluated on an equal-area local 25 km grid
release_planner.logistics_method: greedy sequence using declared soft context multipliers and transit cost

known_but_not_global_quality_context.scope: a requested approximately 17,000 km2 review region, not all campaigns
known_but_not_global_quality_context.limitation: Published totals do not supply a complete reusable global holiday geometry or calibrated PoD.
